# Deep Clean

> Deep Clean (written DEEP CLEAN on the logo, website deepclean.au) is a boutique cleaning company based in Birkdale, QLD 4159. Founded and run by Amie Eckhardt. Regular house cleaning, one-off deep cleans, post-construction (builders) cleans and NIISQ / externally funded cleaning across Brisbane Bayside, the Redlands and south-east Brisbane. Insured and police checked.

## Services

- [One-off Deep Clean](https://deepclean.au/md/deep-cleaning-brisbane.md): A one-off deep clean for the jobs a regular clean never gets to. Booked by Brisbane Bayside locals and homeowners across south-east Brisbane.
- [Recurring Domestic Clean](https://deepclean.au/md/recurring-house-cleaning.md): Weekly, fortnightly or monthly cleaning from the same small, trusted team. Choose Basic for the essentials or Premium for extra detail every visit.
- [Post Construction Clean](https://deepclean.au/md/post-construction-cleaning-brisbane.md): Handover-ready cleans for builders, renovators and homeowners. We make your client's forever home ready to move into.
- [NIISQ & Funded Cleaning](https://deepclean.au/md/niisq-cleaning.md): Approved cleaning provider for NIISQ participants and other externally funded programs across Brisbane Bayside and the Redlands.

## How quoting works

Quotes are free. Tell us about the home (suburb, size, which service, how often) by phone or the quote form. Every quote is an estimate until a quick walk-through, then the final price is confirmed.
